kind: two arms of array mode, paired by seed

confirmatory_family.statement: Seeds paired across the two arms: exact two-sided signed-rank tests of elbo_err, gskl, mmtv and exact McNemar tests of usability for each of 24 configurations; 96 tests under one Holm correction at alpha 0.05, fixed before the runs.

boost_usability_basis: each arm's in-run metrics of its pre-boost, candidate and returned posteriors (its boost reports), computed by that arm's own code; the pre-boost and candidate posteriors are not rescored, so these counts are not those of the rescored metrics
